verdict.rationale: v0 explicitly supports scaffolding full-stack apps, connecting to backends/databases, and building data-driven applications from a single prompt (v0-docs-15, v0-docs-24, v0-docs-28, v0-docs-35), and a community case study confirms a full-stack internal app (auth, roles, export) was built and shipped from prompts in one workflow (v0-comm-1).
